faqItems.question: What is the best milk substitute for baking?
faqItems.answer: Oat milk is the best overall milk substitute for baking. It has a creamy texture, neutral flavor, and works as a 1:1 replacement in most recipes including cakes, muffins, and pancakes.

faqItems.question: Can I use water instead of milk in cake?
faqItems.answer: Yes, but add 1 tablespoon of melted butter per cup of water to replace the fat content. This will help maintain moisture and richness in your cake.

faqItems.question: What milk substitute works for mac and cheese?
faqItems.answer: Oat milk or soy milk work best for mac and cheese as they're creamy and neutral. Avoid almond milk as it's too thin. For extra richness, use evaporated milk diluted with water.

faqItems.question: Is almond milk good for baking?
faqItems.answer: Almond milk works for baking but is thinner than dairy milk. It's best for pancakes and muffins. For richer recipes, add 1 tablespoon of oil per cup or choose oat milk instead.

faqItems.question: What can I substitute for heavy cream in pasta?
faqItems.answer: For pasta, use coconut cream for a vegan option (1:1), or milk + butter (3/4 cup milk + 1/4 cup melted butter per cup of heavy cream). Cashew cream also works well and has a neutral flavor.

faqItems.question: Can I use milk instead of heavy cream?
faqItems.answer: Yes, but add butter to compensate for fat content. Mix 3/4 cup whole milk with 1/4 cup melted butter to replace 1 cup heavy cream. Note: this won't whip.

faqItems.question: What is a dairy-free heavy cream substitute?
faqItems.answer: Coconut cream is the best dairy-free substitute as it's rich and can be whipped. For savory dishes, cashew cream (soaked cashews blended with water) provides a neutral flavor.

faqItems.question: How do I make vegan whipped cream?
faqItems.answer: Chill a can of full-fat coconut milk overnight. Scoop out the solid cream, add powdered sugar, and whip until fluffy. This creates a dairy-free whipped cream substitute.

faqItems.question: What can I use instead of half and half?
faqItems.answer: The best substitute is mixing equal parts whole milk and heavy cream. If you don't have heavy cream, mix 7/8 cup milk with 2 tablespoons melted butter.

faqItems.question: Is half and half the same as heavy cream?
faqItems.answer: No, half and half contains about 12% fat while heavy cream has 36% fat. Half and half is lighter and won't whip, but works well in sauces and coffee.

substitutes.name: heavy_cream_whip
substitutes.notes: Heavy cream has more fat (36% vs 30%) so it whips to stiffer peaks and is richer.

substitutes.name: coconut_whip

faqItems.question: Can I use heavy cream instead of whipping cream?
faqItems.answer: Yes, heavy cream and whipping cream are interchangeable. Heavy cream has slightly more fat (36% vs 30%) so it whips to stiffer peaks but works in all the same applications.
